ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Gender and American Music: This course will examine issues of gender in American music composition, performance, and education since the nineteenth century. Composers studied will include Amy Beach, Ruth Crawford, Florence Price, Ellen Taaffe Zwilich, and Julia Wolfe. Additionally, we will look at gender and music patronage through the twentieth century, as well as issues of gender and diversity in post-secondary institutions through to the present.
